test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Among the following, which of these are an example of capital receipt?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Borrowings and loan recovery.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Capital receipt** refers to the** inflow of funds** that do not result from the** regular business operations** of a company.
 
• **Borrowings** and** loan recovery** are examples of **capital receipts** because they involve the** inflow of funds** that are not generated from the company's regular business activities.
 
• **Borrowings** refer to the funds borrowed by a company from **external sources** such as **banks or financial institutions.**
 
• **Loan recovery **refers to the **repayment of loans** that were previously taken by the company.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rent and commission received, sale of goods and rent, and commission and dividend received are not examples of capital receipt because they are generated from the** regular business operations** of a company.
 
• **Rent and commission** received are** revenues earned by a company** for providing services or renting out property.
 
• **Sale of goods** and rent refers to the sale of goods and the** rental income earned from that sale.**
 
• **Commission and dividend** received are payments made to a company for services rendered or as a **return on investment in shares.**
